description: Na₂HoNb₅O₁₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mbm space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.69 Å) and four longer (2.93 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ho is bonded to twelve O atoms to form HoO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with two equivalent HoO₁₂ cuboctahedra and faces with eight equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.58 Å) and eight longer (2.66 Å) Ho-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-33°. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent HoO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-43°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.08 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ho and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Ho and two equivalent Nb atoms.
